title: Union of irreducible boundary components
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $H,B\subset X$ closed subschemes [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Say that $H$ is a union of irreducible components of $B$ when every irreducible component of $|H|$ is an irreducible component of $|B|$ [def-weil-irreducible-components]. Explicitly, for every irreducible closed subset $Z\subset |X|$ maximal among those contained in $|H|$, $Z$ is contained in $|B|$ and maximal among the irreducible closed subsets contained there. This condition depends only on the supports, and is unchanged by reduction [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction]; it permits $H=\varnothing$.
